changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO catalog_item_sub_modules (catalog_item_id, sub_module_id) SELECT ci.id, sm.id FROM ( SELECT 'CORE' AS item_code, 'OWNERS_ANIMALS' AS sub_module_code UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'COMPANY' UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'BRANCH' UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'EMPLOYEES' UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'ROLES' UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'SUBSCRIPTION' UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'QUOTE' UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'ENTITLEMENT' UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING' UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT' UNION ALL SELECT 'CORE', 'DUNNING' UNION ALL SELECT 'SCHEDULING', 'AGENDA' UNION ALL SELECT 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'CLINICAL_HISTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'MEDICAMENTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'VACCINATION_DEWORMING', 'VACCINATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'VACCINATION_DEWORMING', 'DEWORMING' UNION ALL SELECT 'HOSPITALIZATION', 'HOSPITALIZATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'SURGERY', 'SURGERY' UNION ALL SELECT 'LAB_IMAGING', 'LABORATORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'LAB_IMAGING', 'DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGING' UNION ALL SELECT 'GROOMING', 'SPA' UNION ALL SELECT 'GROOMING', 'DAYCARE' UNION ALL SELECT 'SERVICES', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'SERVICES', 'PROMOTIONS' UNION ALL SELECT 'CASH_REGISTER', 'CASH' UNION ALL SELECT 'CASH_REGISTER', 'TAXES' UNION ALL SELECT 'INVENTORY', 'INVENTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'PURCHASES', 'PURCHASES' UNION ALL SELECT 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING', 'BILLING' ) seed JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.code = seed.item_code JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = seed.sub_module_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_item_sub_modules x WHERE x.catalog_item_id = ci.id AND x.sub_module_id = sm.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE cism FROM catalog_item_sub_modules cism JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.id = cism.catalog_item_id WHERE ci.code IN ('CORE','SCHEDULING','CLINICAL_HISTORY','VACCINATION_DEWORMING', 'HOSPITALIZATION','SURGERY','LAB_IMAGING','GROOMING','SERVICES', 'CASH_REGISTER','INVENTORY','PURCHASES','OPEN_ACCOUNTS', 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: UPDATE catalog_item_sub_modules cism JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.id = cism.catalog_item_id SET cism.enabled = TRUE WHERE ci.code IN ('CORE','SCHEDULING','CLINICAL_HISTORY','VACCINATION_DEWORMING', 'HOSPITALIZATION','SURGERY','LAB_IMAGING','GROOMING','SERVICES', 'CASH_REGISTER','INVENTORY','PURCHASES','OPEN_ACCOUNTS', 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING') AND cism.enabled = FALSE;

rollback.comment: Encender una fila puente no tiene vuelta atrás sensata: apagarlas todas dejaría el catálogo sin ningún módulo abierto y el alta de empresa rota.

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: DELETE cism FROM catalog_item_sub_modules cism JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.id = cism.catalog_item_id JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = cism.sub_module_id WHERE ci.code = 'CORE' AND sm.code = 'AGENDA';

rollback.sql: INSERT INTO catalog_item_sub_modules (catalog_item_id, sub_module_id) SELECT ci.id, sm.id FROM catalog_items ci JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = 'AGENDA' WHERE ci.code = 'CORE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_item_sub_modules x WHERE x.catalog_item_id = ci.id AND x.sub_module_id = sm.id);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO catalog_item_dependencies (catalog_item_id, related_item_id, relation_type, note) SELECT a.id, b.id, seed.relation_type, seed.note FROM ( SELECT 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING' AS item_code, 'CASH_REGISTER' AS related_code, 'REQUIRES' AS relation_type, 'Facturar electrónicamente necesita el módulo de Caja' AS note UNION ALL SELECT 'CAPACITY_TERMINAL', 'CASH_REGISTER', 'REQUIRES', 'Las terminales de caja necesitan el módulo de Caja' UNION ALL SELECT 'EXTRA_TERMINAL', 'CASH_REGISTER', 'REQUIRES', 'Las terminales de caja necesitan el módulo de Caja' UNION ALL SELECT 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS', 'CASH_REGISTER', 'REQUIRES', 'Las cuentas abiertas se cierran cobrando en caja' UNION ALL SELECT 'PURCHASES', 'INVENTORY', 'REQUIRES', 'Registrar compras necesita Inventario para recibir la mercancía' UNION ALL SELECT 'HOSPITALIZATION', 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'REQUIRES', 'La hospitalización cuelga de la historia clínica del paciente' UNION ALL SELECT 'SURGERY', 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'REQUIRES', 'La cirugía se registra dentro de la historia clínica' UNION ALL SELECT 'LAB_IMAGING', 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'REQUIRES', 'Los resultados de laboratorio se adjuntan a la historia clínica' UNION ALL SELECT 'EXTRA_STORAGE', 'LAB_IMAGING', 'REQUIRES', 'El almacenamiento se consume con los archivos de laboratorio e imagen' UNION ALL SELECT 'INVENTORY', 'CASH_REGISTER', 'RECOMMENDS', 'Con Caja, el inventario descuenta solo al vender' UNION ALL SELECT 'CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'SCHEDULING', 'RECOMMENDS', 'La historia clínica se llena sola desde las citas' UNION ALL SELECT 'VACCINATION_DEWORMING', 'SCHEDULING', 'RECOMMENDS', 'Los refuerzos se programan como citas' UNION ALL SELECT 'GROOMING', 'SCHEDULING', 'RECOMMENDS', 'Los baños se agendan como citas' ) seed JOIN catalog_items a ON a.code = seed.item_code JOIN catalog_items b ON b.code = seed.related_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_item_dependencies x WHERE x.catalog_item_id = a.id AND x.related_item_id = b.id AND x.relation_type = seed.relation_type);

rollback.sql: DELETE cid FROM catalog_item_dependencies cid JOIN catalog_items a ON a.id = cid.catalog_item_id WHERE a.code IN ('ELECTRONIC_INVOICING','CAPACITY_TERMINAL','EXTRA_TERMINAL', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS','PURCHASES','HOSPITALIZATION','SURGERY', 'LAB_IMAGING','EXTRA_STORAGE','INVENTORY','CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'VACCINATION_DEWORMING','GROOMING');

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO bundle_components (bundle_item_id, component_item_id, quantity) SELECT b.id, c.id, 1 FROM ( SELECT 'PACK_SPA' AS bundle_code, 'CORE' AS component_code UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_SPA', 'SCHEDULING' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_SPA', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_SPA', 'GROOMING' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_SPA', 'CASH_REGISTER' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_SPA', 'CAPACITY_TERMINAL' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_CLINIC', 'CORE' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_CLINIC', 'SCHEDULING' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_CLINIC', 'CLINICAL_HISTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_CLINIC', 'VACCINATION_DEWORMING' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_CLINIC', 'CASH_REGISTER' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_CLINIC', 'CAPACITY_TERMINAL' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'CORE' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'SCHEDULING' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'CLINICAL_HISTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'VACCINATION_DEWORMING' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'HOSPITALIZATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'SURGERY' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'LAB_IMAGING' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'GROOMING' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'SERVICES' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'CASH_REGISTER' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'CAPACITY_TERMINAL' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'INVENTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'PURCHASES' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'PACK_FULL', 'ELECTRONIC_INVOICING' ) seed JOIN catalog_items b ON b.code = seed.bundle_code JOIN catalog_items c ON c.code = seed.component_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bundle_components x WHERE x.bundle_item_id = b.id AND x.component_item_id = c.id);
